lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-luminance circular pixel clusters arranged in five to six irregular horizontal rows starting posterior to the gill slits, showing increased spatial density in the mid-flank area.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated luminance intersect with the circular nodes, forming a localized grid-like arrangement across the central lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct longitudinal linear features are visible on the upper flank, characterized by a sharp vertical gradient transition from high pixel intensity on the superior edge to shadow-cast low intensity on the inferior edge.

other_distinctive_markers: Localized cluster of high-chroma yellow pixel clusters near the anterior-ventral boundary; network of light refraction caustics overlaid on the posterior epidermal pixels.
